title: Kawaii Fire Fighter — a chibi firefighter vs. waves of angry kawaii flames (free browser demo)
author: Sad-Baker-8793
selftext:
Hi, I've developed an AI-powered game. It's not finished yet; it's a demo available on itch. I'd appreciate your honest feedback on this demo and suggestions for improvements to the gameplay and graphics.

The graphics were reworked by me, but the AI ​​helped me make copies, and I used it for certain elements. The sounds are generated by AI, but I think I'll change that because I'm not satisfied with their quality.

Claude helped me with the code.

A shiny chibi firefighter, a Japanese village that never stops burning.

Read the wind (it pushes the fire — watch the compass), cut the flames' path before they spread with your axe, and rescue villagers hiding in burning cabins before they collapse. Survive 6 escalating waves to win.

Made solo in Godot. It's an early, honest demo — would love feedback!  
▶ Play free in browser: [https://cyberyanis.itch.io/kawaii-fire-fighter](https://cyberyanis.itch.io/kawaii-fire-fighter)

comments.author: Sad-Baker-8793
comments.body: Don't be shy! Test it! And give me your honest opinions.
